354:t_101:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Now that $$刹那$$ has awakened as an $$イノベイター$$, I want to know...! As the $$イノベイド$$ who guides him!)

354:t_102:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we retake $$ヴェーダ$$, it'll be a powerful asset in the battles ahead...!」

354:t_102:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We'll make this mission... a success!」

354:t_103:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You damned $$スフィア・リアクター$$s! Since you rejected the Empire's invitation, nothing awaits you but miserable defeat!」

354:t_103:1.en:
$n
「You just assume we'll lose... Is that the standard villain's threat?」

354:t_103:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oh...! That kind of smile ain't bad either, $n!」

354:t_103:3.en:
$n
「How about I call it the $$ダークスマイル$$?」

354:t_103:4.en:
$$メール$$
「You have absolutely no sense for naming things.」

354:t_103:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「There's no time to mope, $n! Let's hurry and finish $$ストラウス$$'s lackey!」

354:t_103:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「What do you mean, lackey?! I... I am!!」

354:t_104:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「This is payback for $$ラース・バビロン$$! Take all you can handle!」

354:t_104:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「I can tell! You're fired up under that armor, too!」

354:t_104:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here I come! I'll blow you away, armor and all!」

354:t_105:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I never imagined I'd fight in an EVA in this world again...)

354:t_105:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(That $$綾波$$ isn't the $$綾波$$ I know...)

354:t_105:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't understand... I don't understand anything...)

354:t_105:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
($$カヲル$$'s here... As long as he's here... I can fight...)

354:t_105:9.en:
$$シンジ$$
(All I can do now is fight... With $$カヲル$$ and the $$綾波$$ I don't know...)

354:t_106:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「This isn't the world we were in. Isn't bringing those relationships here a bit tactless?」

354:t_106:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「Then what was that burning gaze you were giving Puppy, nya~?」

354:t_106:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, whatever. It looks like we'll be spending a while with them.」

354:t_106:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「Stop! If we don't get through this, there won't be anything after it.」

354:t_106:8.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Four-Eyes! You don't have to tell me...!」

354:t_106:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「All right, all right. Take your anger out on the enemy, Princess.」
